name: standard-runtime-profiling
goal: Standard runners record actual registered operations through Harness profiling with preserved behavior, source scope, benchmark boundaries and truthful missing coverage.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Existing backend behavior tests execute real source but do not emit operation-boundary profiles. The internal adapter scaffold at9a259e6e intentionally has no transform operation and is not enabled. Real captures must bind registered source without timing entire tests or replaying effects.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Replace the generated constructor-only test with source-runner boundary coverage: sync and async operations, private-field receivers, cached Promise identity, rejection propagation, argument/result privacy, unknown source and generator deferral. Fixture metrics stay in an owned temporary sink; self-profiles time the actual transformer.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed01669429 red proof2c53496af68bb7a1a9d4ac03ac564045701939907eb24a3674d10673d3af543c: all five unchanged cases fail because adapter.transform is absent.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Transform only unambiguously registered module source in memory; wrap declared callable boundaries with Harness observations. Preserve receivers and promises, skip generators/accessors, and keep fixture values out of captures.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Internal adapter plus cohesive source-transform/runtime modules; five unchanged actual Bun execution cases pass. Realpath ownership is required; source and public SDK remain unchanged.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Paired redc3859108 and green22887d5b run the unchanged five-case corpus and command in one environment. Green source d53cc616 passed; two real adapter latency and whole-process RSS measurements retained.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: The isolated snapshot at01669429 reintroduces the missing transform boundary and fails all five normal cases; unchanged repaired snapshot d53cc616 passes. Full task verification remains pending.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
